I've reviewed the tree, memory, and site files. The key issue I see: the `addSkipLink` function in `site/app.js` focuses the `<main>` element when activated, but never scrolls to it — so a keyboard user pressing "Skip to content" has focus move but the viewport stays at the top. That's a real accessibility bug.

I'll fix it by adding `main.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })` to both the click and keydown handlers, and record it in MEMORY.md.

Files I intend to rewrite:
- `site/app.js` — add scroll-to-main in skip link handlers (2 lines)
- `MEMORY.md` — record the fix

Risk: low — two one-line additions to an existing function; no API or data changes.
